column16: 1. This template is used to import document level term settings to the system. Before doing this, make sure you have already configured document level term settings on the sites container node in the system.
2. The combination of Site Collection, Site, List/Library, and Folder column values will be the URL of the object where you want to customise document level term settings.
3. If a list/library exists in the top-level site, enter the period . as the Site column value.
4. To successfully import the document level term settings, make sure the defined term scope and default term exist in the system.
5. If the defined default term is not the first-tier term under the defined term scope, enter the term path to help find the exact default term.

column16: 6. For the manual approval type, you need to fill in the correct options.  Note that Not Configured means that you do not want to configure manual approval settings via the template.
7. Site collection, site, List/Library, and Folder must belong to the container.
8. Make sure the container has column settings when importing container settings.
